blocks.text: Scrap Metal Removal Services

c: Removing scrap metal involves more than just basic hauling – it requires careful sorting, safe handling, and environmentally responsible recycling. At Live Junk Free, our professional scrap metal removal service provides complete solutions for all types of metal waste, from household appliances to industrial materials and construction debris.

We specialize in comprehensive appliance and scrap metal removal, handling everything from old refrigerators and washing machines to automotive parts, plumbing fixtures, and structural steel. Our experienced team arrives fully equipped to safely remove and transport your metal waste while following all recycling protocols.

blocks.text: FAQs – Scrap Metal Removal

items.q: What types of scrap metal do you remove?
a: We remove all types, including copper, aluminum, steel, brass, appliances, electronics, auto parts, wiring, and industrial metals.

items.q: How much does scrap metal removal cost?
a: The cost of scrap metal removal depends on the type and quantity of metal, the amount of labour required, and the location of the pickup. As a junk removal service, we typically calculate the price based on the volume of scrap metal, accessibility, and transportation requirements.

items.q: What areas do you serve for scrap metal removal?
a: We service all of GTA, including residential, commercial, and industrial properties.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day scrap metal pickup?
Do you recycle all collected scrap metal?
a: Absolutely! 100% of materials go to certified recycling facilities.

items.q: Do I need to separate different types of metal?
a: No need – our team handles all sorting. Though separated metals may get you better rates.

items.q: Will you remove large or heavy scrap metal items?
a: Yes! We have equipment to safely remove heavy machinery, vehicles, and bulk metal.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing scrap metal collection for businesses?
a: Yes! We provide scheduled pickups and containers for businesses with regular scrap metal.
